# Game-icons.net — original ability symbols

Human-authored symbols by Lorc, Delapouite and the named contributors in SELECTIONS.json, from https://game-icons.net / https://github.com/game-icons/icons .

Pinned revision: `c547b7e4941d83bba737cd97a0a168e6719a7807` (31 October 2020). The historical revision predates generative-image tools. Every selected original SVG is copied unchanged into `prototype/assets/ability_symbols/`; no tracing, recoloring of source files or synthesized images are used. The game scales these vector symbols and applies presentation tints at runtime. Godot imports them at 64px for the HUD; small menu textures are rendered from those imports.

Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/ . The original licence is retained. Credits are available through Main menu → More → Art credits. SELECTIONS.json maps every ability (including spells, weapon attacks and generated faces) to a distinct original icon, author, source URL and hash.
